subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should unrecovered Telegram/channel stalls escalate to supervised Gateway process recovery, or should OpenClaw keep recovery inside channel/session layers until an affected-host repro identifies the exact blocker?
rationale: Current code intentionally caps channel restarts without exiting, while the reported failure is process-level unresponsiveness; changing that boundary affects operator behavior and active sessions.

options.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open, collect current-main affected-host proof, and choose process-level recovery only if narrower channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

options.title: Add Supervised Recovery Policy
options.body: Define a bounded Gateway watchdog or process-exit policy for unrecovered channel stalls and require upgrade notes plus Windows proof.

options.title: Stay Channel-Scoped
options.body: Continue fixing only narrower Telegram/session bugs and avoid process-level recovery unless a fresh repro proves it is required.

recommendation.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, collect current-main affected-host proof, and choose process-level recovery only if narrower channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored recent Telegram polling watchdog work and already ran the most targeted repro attempt documented on this issue.
